build_charcter_tokenizer: build a CharcterTokenizer instance with a 26-character alphabet and special BOS EOS tokens
encode_string_to_tokens: encode a space-free string into a list of integer token IDs with optional BOS and EOS tokens
decode_tokens_to_string: decode a list of integer token IDs back into the original string using the reversed mapping
create_alphabet_mapping: create an alphabet mapping dictionary for a given vocab size with block and query separator characters
get_token_offsets: get the decoded characters and their byte offsets for a given text and optional token list
